message: We all know how frustrating it can be when our phones or tech decide to give up on us at the most inconvenient moments. Having a plan for our vehicles can really help ease those worries. Whether it’s a flat tire or a dead battery, being prepared means we can handle these hiccups without the added stress. Let's take a moment to explore the resources available to us—and remember, it’s about feeling ready, not overwhelmed. What’s one thing you’ve done to prepare for a trip lately? 🚗
